questions.learningObjective: Compute a missing angle in a triangle with known sum
questions.stem: On the costing sheet, a triangle has angles of seventy-two and thirty-eight degrees; what is the third angle in degrees?
questions.explanation: Triangle angles sum to one hundred eighty degrees. One hundred eighty minus seventy-two minus thirty-eight equals seventy degrees.
questions.hint: Subtract both known angles from one hundred eighty.
